scent_diffusion.note: Share of a cell's blood that spreads to its 6 neighbours each second (2.5% each)

scent_current_advect.note: How much of the local current velocity carries blood (0 = none, 1 = fully)

scent_floor.note: Below this a cell reads 0 (keeps the grid sparse)

scent_visible_min.note: Blood plume particles start at this cell value

blood_wound_fraction_min.note: A beast below full HP bleeds at least 10% of its size x 2 per s

blood_corpse_burst.note: Death releases size x 20 at once

blood_corpse_trickle.note: A corpse then trickles 5% of its burst per second until eaten

blood_corpse_life_s.note: How long a corpse lasts with no scavengers

blood_scavenger_rate.note: How fast scavengers remove corpse blood

blood_melee_mult.note: Melee kills make half the blood

sample_range_mult.note: A beast samples the grid out to its scent_m

threshold_hysteresis.note: Stops investigating when local blood falls below 70% of threshold

gradient_step_m.note: Investigate moves toward the highest neighbouring cell at this stride

sight_cone_deg.note: Field of view for sight (blind species: 0)

sight_in_silt_mult.note: Sight range in silt or ink clouds

lamp_visibility_bonus_m.note: A lit lamp adds this to the range any sighted beast sees the diver from

noise_gunshot_base.note: Weapon noise 1-10 maps to field value x 10

fear_flee_threshold.note: Fearful beasts (fear > 0.6) flee sound above this

curious_approach_threshold.note: Curious beasts (curiosity > 0.5) approach sound between 8 and 25

aggressive_attack_threshold.note: Aggressive beasts (aggression > 0.7) attack the source above this

alarm_inside_hull_mult.note: Sunken Ship inside region (hull carries sound)

alarm_reset_on_spawn.note: Alarm halves when a squad spawns

alarm_min_distance_m.note: Squads never spawn closer than this to a diver

hunt_weight_at_hunger.note: How much hunger raises Hunt over Graze/Rest

fed_duration_s.note: After eating, hunger resets and Hunt is suppressed

eat_time_s.note: Time to consume prey of that size

investigate_timeout_s.note: Give up investigating if the source isn't found

hunt_give_up_distance_m.note: Abandon a chase beyond this from home (territorial) or start (wanderer: 200)

flee_trail_blood_mult.note: A fleeing beast bleeds at half rate and stops 10 s after reaching home

defend_escalation_s.note: Territorial: warning display for 3 s, then attack

return_home_calm_s.note: Return home after 20 s without stimuli

school_scatter_s.note: Regroup delay after a shot into the school

pack_roles.note: Packs assign roles; the leader is marked (ink ring) and packs break for 15 s if it dies

swarm_contact_dps_mult.note: Swarm damage scales with bodies overlapping the diver

spawn_check_interval_s.note: Region spawn pools are checked every 10 s

capacity_flora_mult.note: Grazer capacity scales with local flora density (0.5-1.5)

predator_patrol_by_prey.note: Extra predator visit chance per second per 10 grazers in a region

apex_wander_interval_s.note: How often a wandering apex picks a new region

cleaner_calm_radius_m.note: Hosts within this of a cleaner station lose 20% aggression

cleaner_loss_penalty.note: Killing all cleaners in a region: +20% aggression map-wide for 300 s

graze_rate.note: Flora units eaten per grazer per second

enemy_weapon_tier_every.note: Weapons upgrade every 5 tides; Forged at 15+

enemy_blood_yield.note: Ichor for Lost Ones uses the same value in the ichor channel

ichor_repel_s.note: Apex avoid ichor cells for this long
